about_the_game:
Update Log(20250428):

A brand-new Steam demo is about to start (currently under review). Join our Discord be a cyber supervisor and enjoy the life of hunting cats!

<Cat Gladiator> is developed by a three-person team inspired by our shared passion for the Monster Hunter series. As long-time fans of hunting-action games, we aim to create a cooperative hunting experience with appropriately simplified weapon mechanics, accessible boss difficulty, and enhanced prop usage – all to introduce more players to this thrilling genre.

In the game, you play as a middle-aged hunter cat who gets laid off and becomes a gladiator to make ends meet. Grab your weapons and team up with fellow cats to battle colossal bosses in the arena!

Co-op with Friends

Struggling alone? Team up with up to 3 friends for 4-player online co-op! Enjoy the thrill of dominating your foes together.

Challenging Combat

The enemies in the arena are not to be underestimated! To emerge victorious, players must keenly observe and memorize their attack patterns, utilizing their weapon's unique traits to counter effectively. Of course, the enhancements from equipment and the strategic use of props are also crucial to success.

Diverse Weapon Styles

Diverse Weapons

Six distinct weapons available:

Sword & Shield: Balanced offense/defense with guard capabilities.

Longsword: Graceful evasions (Foresight Slash) and lethal counterattacks (Iaiai Slash).

Gun: Cycle between sustained DPS and charged attacks, with dodge-triggered rapid shots.

Greatsword: Deliver devastating charged strikes.

Dual Blades: Unleash whirlwind combos with agile dashes.

Harp: Ranged musical attacks that buff allies.

Each weapon offers unique combat rhythms and playstyles.

Rich and Varied Props

Traps, explosive barrels, healing potions, basketball bombs, grilled fish buffs – master props to tip battles in your favor.

Equipment with Various Functions

Using materials dropped by enemies, players can craft equipment with different appearances and functions. Whether it's boosting attack, defense, critical hit rate, or reducing the cooldown and speeding up the activation of items, the combinations of equipment functions are waiting for players to explore.

The game is still in development – your feedback matters! Planned full-release features include more bosses, props, weapons, gear, and a Cat Meal system. Join us in shaping this adventure!

short_description: CatGladiator is a 2D co-op game.  A middle-aged cat hunter who has been laid off finds  a job as a gladiator to make ends meet.  With a wooden sword in hand, he teams up with his cat  companions to fight against the bosses in the arena!
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
